newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction 55 mln pounds in 91-day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction 55 mln pounds in 91-day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will auction up to 55 million Cyprus pounds ($107 million) worth of 91 day treasury bills with a July 2 issue date, the bank said on Tuesday.
Competitive or non-competitive bids for the issue can be made from June 30 to July 2 at 0900 a.m. local (0600 GMT).

The central bank defines competitive bids as those where the bidder will set the price they are willing to pay to buy the bills. The bid can be accepted either in part or in whole only if the price set is equal or higher than the price set by the central bank for the specific issue.
Non-competitive bids, which have to be marked as such, are those where the bidder states his intention to purchase bills at the average price of competitive bids accepted by the central bank.
The central bank is due to auction up to 30 million pounds worth of 91-day bills on Wednesday, with a June 25 issue date.
Tenders for the issue can be made until 0600 GMT on Wednesday. ($=0.514 pound)
